title: Estimating Standard: Demolition and Haul-Away of Damaged Other Structures under the HomeGuard Homeowners Policy
content:
**Estimating standard for HomeGuard Homeowners Policy other-structures supplementals: tearing out and hauling away the damaged structure.**

**Clause.** A demolition and haul-away allowance for tearing out the damaged structure is added by the structure's recorded depreciation share. The allowance is 4 percent of the other-structures replacement-cost value when the recorded depreciation is at least 25 percent of that value, and 2 percent when it is at least 10 percent but below 25 percent. No allowance is added below 10 percent, where a nearly new structure is repaired in place.

**Figures read.** The recorded depreciation and the replacement-cost value are both those on the claim's actual-cash-value initial payment entry for other structures. The depreciation share is the recorded depreciation divided by that replacement-cost value, stated as a percentage.

**Effect.** The allowance is added to the other-structures supplemental payment before the payment is floored at 0.00 and rounded to the cent once.

## Input, judgement, result

| Depreciation share | Structure | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 25 percent or more | Aged, torn out | 4 percent of replacement-cost value |
| 10 percent or more, below 25 percent | Newer, torn out | 2 percent of replacement-cost value |
| Below 10 percent | Nearly new, repaired in place | None |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical figures, replacement-cost value 20000.00)

- Depreciation 5000.00: share exactly 25 percent, allowance 4 percent, 800.00.
- Depreciation 4999.99: share just under 25 percent, allowance 2 percent, 400.00.
- Depreciation 2000.00: share exactly 10 percent, allowance 2 percent, 400.00.
- Depreciation 1999.99: share just under 10 percent, no allowance.
